bio: Dr. Kimberlyn Leary is the Emma Bloomberg Lecturer in Public Policy and Management at the Harvard Kennedy School and has served as the Executive Vice President at the Urban Institute and is a Senior Advisor at New America. She was a consulting advisor to the Gates Foundation and previously served as an advisor to the National Math and Science Initiative.
